steps: Run make to build the project

issues.description: QuickJS integration not fully implemented in build system
issues.resolution: Added external QuickJS library from /opt/qjs and updated Makefile to include proper paths and libraries. Implemented proper memory management in the JavaScript engine.

issues.description: Build process has compatibility issues with both TCC and GCC compilers
issues.details: Fixed several compiler issues including: circular header dependency, missing function declarations, struct redefinition issues, json_object_foreach macro errors, json_values_equal function calls, transaction_log API issues, and cookie struct type inconsistencies. Still has linking issues without QuickJS that need addressing for a complete build.
issues.fixDetails: Added forward declarations to break circular dependency, added missing JSON functions, fixed cache_t struct definition, fixed comment formatting in API routes, implemented json_equals function, fixed lock_manager struct redefinition issues, added missing includes (errno.h, sys/stat.h), added proper variable declarations for json_object_foreach macro, replaced json_values_equal with json_equals, fixed cookie_t struct definition, added helper functions for JSON operations, created comprehensive QuickJS mock implementation to enable building without QuickJS, fixed global variable definitions for TOOLS_BUILD mode

issues.description: SSL support currently uses mock implementation
Memory management issues in JavaScript engine integration
issues.resolution: Fixed double-free issues in JavaScript engine by implementing a comprehensive reference counting system. Created ref_counter.h/c and ref_json.h/c for shared object management. Reorganized source code for better maintainability. Added proper cleanup of resources and better error handling in js_engine_eval.

issues.description: Type mismatch errors in HTTP response JSON handling
issues.resolution: Fixed JSON string to HTTP response conversion by implementing http_response_from_json_string and http_response_json_string helper functions. Created json_helpers.h utility header for consistent JSON string handling. Updated transaction.c to use the new helpers, avoiding incompatible pointer type warnings. Centralized helper functions by moving them to json_helpers.h for better code reuse.

issues.description: Incorrect return value handling in server initialization causing startup failures
issues.resolution: Created main_fixed.c with proper handling of server_init() and server_start() return values. Fixed server initialization to properly check for SERVER_OK (0) status code rather than treating 0 as false. Added proper initialization of max_connections field and error code. Updated build system to use main_fixed.c instead of main.c.
